## Synopsis

Scans recorded turns for a substring, and/or matches a secret VALUE without
sending it to the server: --value hashes locally (SHA-256) and matches turns
whose FULL content equals the value. Output answers who leaked what, when.
Then rotate the credential.

```
strazactl transcripts search [pattern] [flags]
```

## Options

```
      --limit int      max results (server default 100)
      --user string    narrow to a user (id or username)
      --value string   secret value to match (hashed locally; never sent)
```

## Options inherited from parent commands

```
      --server string   strazad base URL (overrides $STRAZA_SERVER and the server you logged into)
```
